newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 150 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 150 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 150 points in late afternoon trading Tuesday, following a sharp drop in long-term interest rates as financial markets reacted to favorable reports on the economy.

At 3:18 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 154.53 points at 6,937.55. In the bond market, the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond gained 1-18/32, sending its yield down to 6.98 percent from Monday's 7.11 percent. Last Friday the yield was at 7.14 percent.
